comments:
70f4c8d9:  .;
 .;Main entry point to create or update discharge summary.
 .;Checks if necessary to add discharge summary and creates if needed,
 .;or updates existing discharge summary.

d9a54d1b:  .;
 .;DFN       Patient IEN
 .;DGJTDT    Transfer date
 .;DGJPARM   Site parameters
 .;DGJIRTDA  IEN for 393 file
 .;DGJT      Temp global for Movement data
 .;DGJFLG    Flag to indicate if new discharge summary created
 .;DGJTYP    Discharge Summary type IEN
e80b5266: ;Output variable
aee77029: ;Get Site Parameters
7d4752d2: ;Quit if no site parameters
e0cd6ac8: ;Default to 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY' type if not passed
33897e25: ;If IEN passed but no date of discharge, set flag and quit
5446a70f: ;If IEN passed and discharge date exists, quit
7b552386: ;Find discharge summary for this admission, if exists
993c1182: ;If found matching discharge summary, set output variable
79eea9f6: ;If no discharge summary found, call add to create new entry
4fd1a771: ;Quit

f53d4995:  .;
 .;Create new discharge summary entry
 .;Set variables
 .;Create new entry in 393 file
 .;Update fields in new entry
 .;Set status to 'INCOMPLETE'
9d79c912: ;Initialize variables
cb8b184a: ;Get treating specialty
48147690: Set the Treating Specialty to the fifth data piece in the DGPM INSTITUTION SPECIALTY file.
cd564392: Get the seventh piece of DGPM MOVEMENT Entry corresponding to the current admission, which contains the Patient's name.
93254169: Call DOC extrinsic function to get the Dictating Provider's name/title and store it in DGJT9.
dd8aac1d: If the third piece of the DG DISCHARGE SUMMARY PARAMETER element is 1, call DOC extrinsic function to get the Transcriptionist's name/title and store it in DGJT10.
35b53276: Set the Discharge Date to the Admission Date if Transfer Date is null, and set the Discharge Ward to the fourth piece of the Ward Location file entry for the Transfer Ward.
56cb13c3: Create a new entry in the Discharge Summary file (#393) for the patient.
87a7e99c: Set DGJIRTDA to the new entry number if successful, otherwise quit.
f941e208: Lock the new entry in the Discharge Summary file.
561b49a0: Initialize the fields of the new Discharge Summary entry.
872c1bc2: Update the new Discharge Summary entry with the initialized field values.
2dcf4627: Unlock the new Discharge Summary entry.
ea0f9b67: Set the DGJFLG flag to indicate a new Discharge Summary was created.

471fca2e: ;
Update the following fields in an existing Discharge Summary entry:
.10.01 - Date Dictated
.10.02 - Dictated By
.10.03 - Date Transcribed
.10.04 - Transcribed By
.10.05 - Date Signed
.10.06 - Signed By
.10.07 - Date Reviewed
.10.08 - Reviewed By
8f6c290b: Lock the existing Discharge Summary entry.
4509d56f: Set the UPDATE fields for the existing Discharge Summary entry.
98e6fbb5: ;Update the Discharge Summary fields
f6de194c: ;Release lock on Discharge Summary record
665ab386: ;Exit subroutine
a75cd078: ;Lock Discharge Summary record
ebc89854: ;Delete all Discharge Summary field values
0f8d0bb3: ;Execute field delete and update status
947cf24a: ;Release lock on Discharge Summary record
5b79313f: ;Exit subroutine
d5e9397a: ;Lock Discharge Summary record
e214345a: ;Update Discharge Summary signature field values
b69017fc: ;Execute field updates and update status
334566d6: ;Release lock on Discharge Summary record
3733bbe6: ;Exit subroutine
2f3784a3: ;Get DT node of record
7450ebc8: ;If no DATE COMPLETED, set status to INCOMPLETE
1d2a3221: ;If no DICTATED DATE/TIME, set status to DICTATED
d443207a: ;If no TRANSCRIBED DATE/TIME, set status to TRANSCRIBED
75942ac9: ;If no REVIEWED/SIGNED DATE/TIME, and REVIEWED/SIGNED DATE/TIME not required, set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW
dac04369: ;If no REVIEWED DATE/TIME, and REVIEWED/SIGNED DATE/TIME required, set status to SIGNED
ff7f009a: ;If REVIEWED/SIGNED DATE/TIME exists, and REVIEWED/SIGNED DATE/TIME required, set status to REVIEWED
08ce7333: ;Set status in 393 file
8d04382e: ;Quit
59b8510d: ;Quit
78260e0d: ;Get Document Description from ATTENDING DISCHARGE field of parameter
cf98c30b: ;Set Document Description from 2nd or 19th piece of zero node of DGPM file
f38c122e: ;Quit
